ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.

CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM #10A and #10B): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the Board if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 5/13/15 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2015-05-27 Item 8A - Minutes Amended (Page 4)
8B.
Adoption of City Council Ordinance 2015-09, amending the Encinitas Municipal Code to increase the fine from $500 to $1,000. This fine applies in cases where a violation continues to occur following the issuance of the third and subsequent administrative citation. Contact Person: Planning and Building Director Murphy
Adopt City Council Ordinance 2015-06 entitled, "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, amending section 1.08.050 related to increasing enforcement fines from $500 to $1,000."
2015-05-27 Item 8B - Ordinance 2015-09 Admin Fees
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Public Hearing to consider an appeal of the Planning Commission's approval of a Design Review Permit and Coastal Development Permit for grading and construction of a new single-family residence at 1265 Saxony Road. The property is currently undeveloped and located within the Rural Residential-2 (RR-2) Zone, Hillside/Inland Bluff Overlay Zone and the Coastal Zone. The appellant is specifically appealing street improvement requirements, to be constructed along Saxony Road per Planning Commission Resolution No. 2015-09 dated April 2, 2015. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Maher CASE NUMBER: 14-151 DR/CDP; APPLICANT: Dennis and Courtney LeDuc; LOCATION: 1265 Saxony Road (APN 254-180-80)
Deny the appeal and adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015-29 affirming the requirements for public improvements per Planning Commission to approve Case No. 14-151 DR/CDP for the reasons stated in Planning Commission Resolution No. 2015-09 on April 2, 2015, or for such additional findings determined by the City Council to affirm the decision.
2015-05-27 Item 10A - Public Hearing of Public Improvements for 1265 Saxony
10B.
Public Hearing to consider an appeal of the Planning Commission's approval of a Tentative Parcel Map and Coastal Development Permit to subdivide four (4) existing legal lots of record into four (4) residential lots with a remainder parcel and associated site improvements. The subject property is located in the Residential 3 (R-3) zone and within the Scenic/Visual Corridor Overlay Zone and the Coastal Zone. Contact Person: Senior Planner Sapa'u CASE NUMBER: 13-056 TPM/CDP; APPLICANT: Ahmad 'David' Mashayekan and Nepton Arbab; APPELLANT: Donna Westbrook; LOCATION: 825 & 837 Orpheus Avenue (APNs: 256-121-03, -04, -05 & -06)
Deny the appeal and adopt Resolution No. 2015-28 affirming the decision of the Planning Commission to approve a 4-lot subdivision with a remainder parcel and associated site improvements for the reasons outlined under the analysis section of this report. Alternative options are also provided in the analysis section.
2015-05-27 Item 10B - Public Hearing Case 13-056 TPMCDP 825 & 837 Orpheus Avenue
10C.
Final review of FY2015-16/FY2016-17 Operating Budget and FY2015-16 to FY2020-21 Capital Improvement Program and Financial Plan. Contact Person: Finance Director Nash
1) Confirm changes made to the operating budget as a result of Council input received on May 13, 2015; 2) Confirm changes made to the Capital Improvement Program (CIP) as a result of Council input received on March 25, 2015 and April 29, 2015; and 3) Identify additional revisions to the operating and CIP budgets.
2015-05-27 Item 10C - Final Review of Operating and CIP Budget

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
